title: How far will Farhan's family drive today?
description: Farhan's family drives to his grandmother's village. A dial on the dashboard counts the kilometres and the video leaves open how big the number will grow.
teaching_notes: The hook only makes the child curious about big distance numbers. Teach nothing; the free try on the odometer follows.

source: How far did you go on your last trip?
video_script.why: The child wonders how large a trip's distance number can get, which opens the whole chapter.
video_script.substitution: None; the hook teaches nothing and ends on an open question.
video_script.anchor: Farhan's family car on the highway to his grandmother's village, with the kilometre dial on the dashboard
maths_rules: no number is used; the dial is drawn as a row of small wheels with blurred digits that keep turning
the question is open: how far, and how many digits the distance will have
video_script.design: Hook only: a car, a dashboard dial of turning wheels, then an open question. No answer, no formula, no symbol. The free try on the Odometer Reader opens next, where the child turns the wheels and reads the distance.

beats.on_screen: a photo of the family car on the highway sits behind as a dimmed backdrop and fades at the end of the beat; a drawn car on a highway with a village signboard far ahead; a round dial on the dashboard shows a row of small wheels with blurred digits

marks.trip: the car appears on the highway

narration: <bookmark mark='trip'/>Farhan's family is driving to his grandmother's village for the holidays.
<bookmark mark='dial'/>The car has a dial that counts the kilometres.

beats.on_screen: the dial fills the stage; its small wheels turn one after another and the digits stay blurred

marks.wheels: the small wheels begin to turn

narration: <bookmark mark='wheels'/>Little wheels in the dial turn as the road rolls by.
<bookmark mark='grow'/>Hour after hour, the number on the dial keeps growing.

beats.on_screen: the dial holds still with its digits blurred and an empty box beside it; a faint question mark glows

marks.ask: an empty box appears beside the dial
marks.digits: a faint question mark glows over the box

narration: <bookmark mark='ask'/>Farhan wonders how far they will have gone by evening.
<bookmark mark='digits'/>How big will the number on the dial be, and how many digits will it have?
